interactions.flavorLineOne: "I found one more gift for you to finish the festival strong."

"Guardian," Eva intones, face backlit with the flickering light of holiday candles. "Listen now to my tale of vengeance and woe!"

She waggles her outspread fingers, making the shadows around her dance. But her tone is serious.

"I arranged Mystery Grab Bags to give everyone an exciting and meaningful Festival of the Lost. And now some of them have gone missing! I suspect someone hungry, lurking around in a basement… if you catch my DRIFT."

"I see you're ready for the Festival with a very official mask of your own. In the spirit of the season, I'd appreciate if you found the culprit and gave them a good scare."

Eva leans in to whisper conspiratorially to you. "Don't tell the other Guardians, but if you help me out, you can keep one of the bags for yourself."

headerDisplayProperties.name: The Mystery of the Missing Bags

interactions.flavorLineOne:
Eva smiles warmly as you approach. She already holds a small parcel in her hands, as though she had been anticipating your arrival.

"One of my favorite parts of the Dawning is that I get to see my favorite people every day," she says as she hands you the parcel.

"Thank you for taking the time to visit me. Now, go spread this good cheer with the rest of your friends!"

Eva accepts the cookies with a warm smile. "Happy Dawning to you," she says. "Things may be grim at times, but the world is full of things that remind us never to give up hope."

She laughs. "I'm talking about you, Guardian. Of course, the cookies help, too."
"A truly impressive showing! You've proved yourself to be one of the top Guardians of any class. I hope you'll wear this emblem with the pride it deserves." —Eva Levante
"A gift need not be material. Sometimes your presence, a little favor, or some advice is just as welcome. The Dawning is a time to care for one another." —Eva Levante
"What a bounty! I hope you didn't play too many tricks to earn these treats!" —Eva Levante

"Happy Solstice, Guardian."

Eva welcomes you to the celebration, smiling with deep warmth. 

"I am so pleased to see you here. There is always something special about Solstice, isn't there? We remember what has been, and we celebrate the life and hope of here and now, of the future yet to come with the people by our sides."

"I have asked Zavala to devise some exciting new challenges for you to overcome this year, Guardian. You'll have access to these during your Operations this Solstice. It is our hope that these will drive you to ever greater heights, and that you shine brightly for all to see."

"Welcome back, Guardian." 

Eva greets you with a warm smile and a gentle wave. She looks you over and nods.

"I am glad to see you are making good use of the forge, and that you are well on your way to creating the armor of your dreams. I dare say I have nothing else to teach you this year… but I hope you'll keep coming back. There is more to forge, and I am always happy to see you."

Eva claps her hands together as you approach, causing a cloud of cinnamon-scented flour to puff into the air. "How wonderful, Guardian!" she says. "I can use the Dawning Spirit you collect to help spread holiday cheer much more efficiently."

She nudges you. "What, you didn't think old Eva cared about things like maximizing productivity? Trust me, if I could spread Dawning cheer by baking one enormous cookie for the whole Tower instead of a hundred little ones, I would!"

The old woman sighs wistfully. "Maybe someday…"

"Anyway," she says and pats your Holiday Oven, "peek in there to see how much Dawning Spirit you've gathered, and let me know how you're coming along! Let's make this a Dawning to remember!"

Eva's eyes twinkle as she gives you a warm smile. "There you are." 

She reaches behind her, picking up a mask. "I made this just for you. I patterned it from a similar one that Maria had when she was little. Her head was a bit smaller though." 

She chuckles fondly. "Well, try it on!"

Eva's eyes twinkle as she gives you a warm smile. "There you are." 

She reaches behind her, picking up a mask. "I made this just for you. I patterned it from a similar one that Maria had when she was little. Her head was a bit smaller though." 

She chuckles fondly. "Well, try it on!"

Eva grips your hand tightly as you approach and smiles warmly.  "You've been busy this year. I'm sure our new Aionian friends and that adorable Exo puppy were delighted with what you baked them. But no doubt you can come up with a few more recipes to make in that Dawning oven. I'll bet your old friends throughout the system could use a tasty treat. You've all fought hard this year, faced existential dread—again. I'm sure they'll all be glad to spend some time with you outside of a crisis." She gives you a rosy-cheeked wink "Here's a few ingredients to get you started."

The Festival of the Lost is nearing its end. Be sure to collect any remaining masks and participate in all associated activities this week!

Happy Festival of the Lost!

headerDisplayProperties.description: Speak to Eva Levante in the Tower.
headerDisplayProperties.name: The End Is Nigh

interactions.flavorLineOne:
"Did Zavala like his gift?" Eva asks, and then laughs. "Whether he said so or not, I assure you, he did."

She smiles. "Go on, then. Spread some cheer. You'll discover even more ingredients and recipes on your travels. I'm sure you'll find what you need to make gifts for everyone on your list."

"Before you go, Guardian, I have a small gift for you. With this Dawning Spirit, I can give you a bit of an upgrade!"
"Very impressive, Guardian!" Eva smiles warmly. "Now that you've gotten your bearings, you can really start showing off by earning those Medallions!"

"Welcome to the Guardian Games!" Eva greets you warmly. "Once again, Titans, Warlocks, and Hunters will be competing for bragging rights. I've been hard at work with Zavala to set up a new scoring model for this year. Your Light protects us all, Guardian. The least I can do in return is give you a competition to remember!"

Eva indicates a selection of gleaming class items. "Ikora herself gave me a hand with the finishing touches on these. The bonds, marks, or cloaks of our winning class will receive a special something to make sure they stand out in any crowd—just as they will deserve."

"Now, go show the other classes what you're made of," she says with mock seriousness. "If you want those bragging rights, you'll have to earn them!"

"I see you've earned your first Medallion!" Eva claps her hands in delight. "The first of many, I'm sure."

"With skills like yours, you'll soon have more than you know what to do with!" She gives you a friendly wink.

"Here's a little something to hold all of your trophies," she says, handing you a Medallion Case. "Now you'll be able to track all of your class contributions and look back on your achievements with pride."
"Hello, dear. Would you believe that this old lady has a new trick up her sleeve?" she asks with a wink. "If you bring back the mask, I'll tailor some personal touches in. You'll love it."

Welcome to the ceremony! At the end of each week, everyone celebrates their contributions and receives rewards for their efforts. Go to the podium and see how you and your fellow Guardians did this week.

Eva once again appraises your Lustrous armor.

"It's beginning to look rather radiant," she says approvingly. "Why not finish the set out? You will shine like the sun, and I for one always love to see it."

She waves you off beaming, looking forward to your progress.
Put your best Light forward in pursuit of a world-class weapon!

"Welcome to the Dawning, Guardian," Eva says. "At this time of year, the City joins together to celebrate and give thanks for all we have."

She smiles. "And what's a celebration without some fresh-baked treats? Now, I can't do it all myself, so I'm going to lend you my Holiday Oven."

She clasps her hands in excitement. "Oh, I can't wait to see what you come up with! I think you should begin by baking a gift for our dear Commander Zavala."
